reply_body:
Dear Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy,

Thank you for raising this, and I'm sorry to hear about the mix-up.

Our late return fee is normally applied automatically based on when the equipment is checked back in at the depot, and it isn't something we can waive as a matter of course. But if the delay really was on our side — nobody at the depot to receive the equipment at the time you'd agreed — that's a different matter, and I want to look into it properly before anything is decided either way.

I'll check the depot's arrival log and staff schedule for that day and come back to you within the next few working days with what we find. If it confirms your account of events, we'll put it right.

Thank you for your patience, and apologies again for the inconvenience.

Best regards,
Elina Rahkonen
Senior Coordinator, Haapaharju Oy

Hello,

Following up on a few things.

On the €300 damage charge for the scissor lift: I've had this reviewed properly. Once a damage charge has gone through our repair-cost assessment and been communicated to the customer, it's final under our policy and isn't something we're able to renegotiate afterwards, regardless of rental history. So I'm not able to reduce or waive this one, and I know that's not the answer you were hoping for.

On the invoice you needed a copy of — I still don't have a reference for it. Could you let me know the rental or approximate date it relates to, so I can pull the right one?

On the hydraulic concrete breaker: yes, we can deliver it, or you're welcome to collect it from the depot yourself — whichever suits the job better. Let me know your preference along with the dates you need it and I'll get it booked in.

Best regards,
Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager, Haapaharju Oy
